title: The Banker
one_paragraph_synopsis: Michael prepares for a banker's visit related to the sale of Dunder Mifflin, showing off office devices and discussing company achievements, while interacting with staff and addressing HR concerns. The segment highlights Michael’s nervousness about the sale process and office dynamics.

main_threads.thread: Preparation for the banker's visit and office interactions

evidence.snippet: Michael: Dunder Mifflin is about to be sold. But first an investment banker has to drop by and sign off on our branch.
Michael (entEring on a Segway Scooter): I see you've met Computron, our virtual helper.
Toby: I don't know how I'm going to get through this. I don't want to lie and I DON'T want to tell the truth.
Michael: Hey, Tobes. Whatcha doin'? Whatcha guys talkin' about?
